+name: LUMO nextgen English Quiz and Memory authorities
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [chatgpt/lumo-nextgen-feature-20261114]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: lumo-nextgen-authorities-${{ github.sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  HOST_SOURCE: 50503fef8e93700d9a889e33c3d2c37fccb46e42
+  LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE: '1'
+
+jobs:
+  production-authorities:
+    name: ${{ matrix.activity }} actual authority
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        activity: [english, quiz, memory]
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 35
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          path: native-source
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+          repository: Ullmann27/lumo-lernen
+          ref: ${{ env.HOST_SOURCE }}
+          path: host-source
+      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
+        with:
+          flutter-version: '3.44.9'
+          channel: stable
+          cache: true
+      - name: Install the exact verified Godot and actual software renderer
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 update -qq
+          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=2 install -y xvfb libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0
+          curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/4.6.3-stable/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64.zip
+          printf '%s  %s\n' d0bc2113065e481c9c2c2b2c37daa4e8be3fe9e27f0ab9ab0b6096e9a37907f3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" | sha256sum -c -
+          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin"
+          ln -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/Godot_v4.6.3-stable_linux.x86_64" "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin/godot"
+          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/godot-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+      - name: Record exact sources and import the complete original native project
+        id: import_source
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_NATIVE: ${{ github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mkdir -p authority-evidence
+          test "$(git -C native-source rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_NATIVE"
+          test "$(git -C host-source rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_SOURCE"
+          git -C native-source rev-parse HEAD > authority-evidence/NATIVE-SOURCE.txt
+          git -C native-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > authority-evidence/NATIVE-TREE.txt
+          git -C host-source rev-parse HEAD > authority-evidence/HOST-SOURCE.txt
+          git -C host-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}' > authority-evidence/HOST-TREE.txt
+          godot --version > authority-evidence/godot-version.txt
+          dart --version > authority-evidence/dart-version.txt 2>&1
+          python3 native-source/tools/validate_project.py 2>&1 | tee authority-evidence/project-validation.log
+          godot --headless --path native-source --editor --import --quit 2>&1 | tee authority-evidence/import.log
+          if grep -qE 'SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|ERROR:' authority-evidence/import.log; then exit 1; fi
+      - name: Resolve the pinned existing host dependencies
+        id: host_dependencies
+        working-directory: host-source
+        run: flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile
+      - name: Exercise the actual authority for this activity
+        working-directory: host-source
+        env:
+          ACTIVITY: ${{ matrix.activity }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          case "$ACTIVITY" in
+            english)
+              dart run tool/check_native_english_activity.dart --out ../authority-evidence/english-activity.json 2>&1 | tee ../authority-evidence/english-authority.log
+              ;;
+            quiz)
+              dart run tools/android_qa/quiz_round_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee ../authority-evidence/quiz-authority-contract.log
+              ;;
+            memory)
+              dart tools/android_qa/memory_round_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee ../authority-evidence/memory-authority-contract.log
+              dart tools/android_qa/memory_turn_scheduler_contract.dart 2>&1 | tee ../authority-evidence/memory-scheduler-contract.log
+              ;;
+            *) exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+      - name: Exercise English meshes with actual host producer output
+        if: ${{ matrix.activity == 'english' }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-english-data"
+          export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-english-config"
+          export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-english-cache"
+          mkdir -p "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"
+          python3 native-source/tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+            --log authority-evidence/english-render.log --timeout 900 --required LEARNING_ENGLISH_PASS -- \
+            xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path native-source \
+            --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --disable-vsync \
+            --script res://scripts/tests/learning_english_regression.gd -- --capture \
+            --output="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/authority-evidence/english-native" \
+            --task-fixtures="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/authority-evidence/english-activity.json"
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import hashlib, json
+          from pathlib import Path
+          folder = Path('authority-evidence')
+          report = json.loads((folder / 'english-native/learning-english-report.json').read_text())
+          assert report['fixture_kind'] == 'actual_dart_producer_report'
+          assert report['task_fixture_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256((folder / 'english-activity.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+          assert report['failures'] == [] and report['renderer'] != 'headless'
+          assert len(list((folder / 'english-native').glob('*.png'))) == 17
+          PY
+      - name: Play all twenty Quiz questions through the real Dart and Godot processes
+        if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.activity == 'quiz' && steps.import_source.outcome == 'success' && steps.host_dependencies.outcome == 'success' }}
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_NATIVE: ${{ github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' python3 native-source/tools/run_quiz_native_authority.py \
+            --native native-source --host host-source \
+            --expected-native "$EXPECTED_NATIVE" --expected-host "$HOST_SOURCE" \
+            --output authority-evidence/quiz-pair --capture
+      - name: Reject inconsistent Memory pair evidence
+        if: ${{ matrix.activity == 'memory' }}
+        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s native-source/tools/tests -p test_memory_native_pair_evidence.py -v
+      - name: Render the actual Memory geometry and touch layouts
+        if: ${{ matrix.activity == 'memory' }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export XDG_DATA_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-memory-view-data"
+          export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-memory-view-config"
+          export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP/lumo-memory-view-cache"
+          export LUMO_MEMORY_CAPTURE_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/authority-evidence/memory-view"
+          mkdir -p "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME"
+          python3 native-source/tools/run_godot_probe.py \
+            --log authority-evidence/memory-view.log --timeout 900 --required MEMORY_VIEW_PASS -- \
+            xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' godot --path native-source \
+            --rendering-method gl_compatibility --audio-driver Dummy --fixed-fps 60 --disable-vsync \
+            --script res://scripts/tests/memory_table_regression.gd -- --capture
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json
+          from pathlib import Path
+          folder = Path('authority-evidence/memory-view')
+          report = json.loads((folder / 'memory-view-result.json').read_text())
+          assert report['status'] == 'PASS' and report['errors'] == [] and report['capture'] is True
+          assert len(report['captures']) == 8 and len(list(folder.glob('*.png'))) == 8
+          PY
+      - name: Play Memory through the actual Dart and Godot processes
+        if: ${{ !cancelled() && matrix.activity == 'memory' && steps.import_source.outcome == 'success' && steps.host_dependencies.outcome == 'success' }}
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_NATIVE: ${{ github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 2560x2560x24' python3 native-source/tools/run_memory_native_authority.py \
+            --native native-source --host host-source \
+            --expected-native "$EXPECTED_NATIVE" --expected-host "$HOST_SOURCE" \
+            --output authority-evidence/memory-pair --capture
+      - name: Verify both tracked source trees remain unchanged
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git -C native-source diff --exit-code HEAD --
+          git -C host-source diff --exit-code HEAD --
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: lumo-nextgen-actual-authority-evidence-${{ matrix.activity }}
+          path: |
+            authority-evidence/
+            !authority-evidence/**/user/**
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 30

+# English, Memory and Quiz native source integration — 14 November 2026
+
+This development candidate builds on Native9f2e865614262c7176f9fdd987766ff5e45f2551 and pins the actual authority matrix to Host50503fef8e93700d9a889e33c3d2c37fccb46e42. Protected Main is unchanged. An approved combined Android APK does not yet exist.
+
+## Reachable production scenes
+
+The existing learning world consumes the actual Host English descriptor. Fourteen concrete object identities now include every one of the ten Schulsachen words present in each of grades1 and2: book, pen, ruler, bag, rubber, school bag, desk, chair, pencil case and paper. Ball, car, sun and apple remain supported. The seven added school objects use actual runtime mesh geometry and collision targets. Later abstract phrases remain explicitly unsupported rather than receiving an unrelated prop.
+
+The source retains atomic observation of actual controls, selected object, hints, completion, Android insets and projected collision geometry. This observation does not grant mastery, rewards or write a child save. A compact English header reduces vertical padding on narrow layouts; text remains19dp and the action controls remain52dp. English pronunciation and actual Android interaction still require their separate acceptance.
+
+The routed Quiz studio uses original Lumo, a physical podium, question lamps, camera presentation and bounded intents to the production Dart controller. A legitimate null explanation is now accepted and omitted from optional explanatory text. JSON numeric hidden-answer indexes are compared after integer normalization in both display and input guards. The committed original failed authority JSON is replayed by the regression. Questions, joker rules, persistence and wallet settlement remain authoritative on the Host.
+
+Memory retains its routed spatial table, thick artwork-bound cards, flip animation, match marks, page-aware targets and pause/restart/return controls. The renderer consumes public Host state; it has no private deck reader or second rules engine. The original thirteen artwork bytes match the Host. The actual rules, opponent, child journal and rewards remain in Dart.
+
+## Actual evidence already obtained
+
+At Native9f2e, run43603969762 completed the English and Memory jobs successfully. Quiz failed after the actual Host revealed a question whose explanation was null. The original authority state, durable record, layouts, requests and failed log are retained. This failure is not relabelled.
+
+The successful9f2e Memory pair used real Dart and Godot processes with explicit QA disk-transport and award-ledger adapters. It recorded19 requests,19 touch presses and19 releases, three acknowledged returns, unfinished same-round restore, a distinct token on reopen, four completed pairs and one QA award of2 stars/16XP. It contains8 main captures,12 actual flip frames and8 separate presenter captures. This is neither an Android result nor a production-wallet end-to-end measurement.
+
+For the new English sources, the final local headless regression passed7,177 checks with196 actual Godot touch events. The final real renderer passed7,228 checks with196 touches and17 PNGs in867.538 seconds within the unchanged900-second limit. All17 PNGs were individually opened. These new images use the explicitly named native_catalogue_fixture; the new14-word Dart producer has not yet been exercised through this candidate's Native matrix.
+
+For the Quiz correction, the same current regression against the previous product failed17 checks out of208. Against the corrected product it passed215 checks with0 failures and10 actual renderer images. All10 were individually opened. These are local UI/transport fixtures, not a successful rerun of the full twenty-question actual-authority pair.
+
+Host50503 includes the Memory result-frame correction, the current English catalog/producer, and the Studio Android QA corrections. Its actual run43606651298 has failed in the focused Memory UI step; the full Flutter suite is therefore not approved. Its Android Host compile and source-contract jobs passed. Investigation continues independently of the Native source tests.
+
+## Current automated gates
+
+The activity matrix runs English, Quiz and Memory independently with fail-fast disabled. Each job verifies the exact Host/Native commits and trees and checks that tracked sources remain unchanged. English requires the actual Dart-produced descriptor report and17 genuine screenshots. Memory preserves the existing independent pair verifier and300/330-second deadlines. Quiz still requires all twenty questions, three jokers, pause/reopen/return and the once-only5,000-star QA ledger effect.
+
+The complete existing Studio Native workflow is now also enabled on this specific development branch. Its full job requirements and evidence-archive gates are unchanged; enabling this branch does not turn the previous Native344 receipt into acceptance of new scenes.
+
+## Remaining acceptance
+
+The new exact-source authority matrix and full Native workflow must actually pass. The known Host focused failure must be corrected and the full Flutter suite rerun. English, Memory and Quiz Android probes then need the same source-bound APK as the existing general tour, lifecycle, save and update checks. Current screenshots need their own receipt. The separately tested Studio candidate is not automatically the combined feature candidate.
+
+Neither a fixed test clock nor software-renderer timing proves60FPS on a Galaxy Z Fold7. Physical-device CPU/GPU timing, input latency and thermals have not been measured. The remaining legacy Native exit-resource errors also remain documented rather than being described as harmless.
+

+extends Node3D
+## Presentation-only Memory table. The Dart controller owns the deck, opponent,
+## timing, score, settings, persistence and wallet. Hidden motifs never arrive.
+
+const LUMO = preload("res://scripts/characters/lumo/lumo_rigged_actor.gd")
+const OBSERVATION := "user://memory_layout_v1.json"
+const LEVELS := ["leicht", "mittel", "schwer", "knifflig", "profi"]
+const COUNTS := [8, 12, 16, 20, 24]
+const PACKS := ["alle", "tiere", "weltall", "garten"]
+const MOTIFS := {
+	"panda":["Panda","face_panda"], "giraffe":["Giraffe","face_giraffe"],
+	"lumo":["Lumo","fox_avatar"], "hase":["Hase","face_bunny"],
+	"pinguin":["Pinguin","face_penguin"], "stern":["Sternchen","sticker_star"],
+	"laterne":["Laterne","sticker_lantern"], "truhe":["Schatztruhe","sticker_chest"],
+	"note":["Notenfreund","sticker_note"], "fahne":["Sternenfahne","sticker_flag"],
+	"pilz":["Pilz","sticker_mushroom"], "stein":["Stachelstein","sticker_rock"]
+}
+const CARD_ASPECT := 0.76
+var _host: Object
+var _token := ""
+var _state: Dictionary = {}
+var _previous: Dictionary = {}
+var _sequence := 0
+var _pending := 0
+var _poll := 0.0
+var _closed := false
+var _round := ""
+var _page := 0
+var _page_size := 24
+var _columns := 4
+var _rows := 6
+var _cards: Array[Dictionary] = []
+var _textures: Dictionary = {}
+var _dirty := true
+var _layout_frames := 2
+var _layout_sequence := 0
+var _retry_at := 0
+var _density := 1.0
+var _safe_rect := Rect2()
+var _board_rect := Rect2()
+var _dismissed_result := ""
+var camera: Camera3D
+var fox: Node3D
+var ui: Control
+var safe: Control
+var header: PanelContainer
+var footer: PanelContainer
+var overlay: PanelContainer
+var menu_scroll: ScrollContainer
+var title: Label
+var scores: Label
+var status: Label
+var detail: Label
+var page_label: Label
+var back_button: Button
+var pause_button: Button
+var resume_button: Button
+var restart_button: Button
+var previous_button: Button
+var next_button: Button
+var level_buttons: Array[Button] = []
+var pack_buttons: Array[Button] = []
+var _theme: Theme
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	var window := get_window()
+	_previous = {"scale":window.content_scale_size,"mode":window.content_scale_mode,
+		"quit":get_tree().quit_on_go_back,"accept":get_tree().auto_accept_quit,
+		"orientation":DisplayServer.screen_get_orientation()}
+	window.content_scale_mode = Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_CANVAS_ITEMS
+	get_tree().quit_on_go_back = false
+	get_tree().auto_accept_quit = false
+	if OS.has_feature("mobile"):
+		DisplayServer.screen_set_orientation(DisplayServer.SCREEN_SENSOR)
+	if _host == null and Engine.has_singleton("LumoHost"):
+		_host = Engine.get_singleton("LumoHost")
+	_token = str(HostBridge.launch_options().get("tableToken", ""))
+	_build_room()
+	_build_ui()
+	window.size_changed.connect(_layout)
+	MobileRuntime.safe_area_changed.connect(_layout)
+	_layout()
+	_poll_state()
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	_closed = true
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(OBSERVATION)
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(OBSERVATION + ".tmp")
+	_clear_cards()
+	if MobileRuntime.safe_area_changed.is_connected(_layout):
+		MobileRuntime.safe_area_changed.disconnect(_layout)
+	if get_window().size_changed.is_connected(_layout):
+		get_window().size_changed.disconnect(_layout)
+	if not _previous.is_empty():
+		get_window().content_scale_size = _previous.scale
+		get_window().content_scale_mode = _previous.mode
+		get_tree().quit_on_go_back = _previous.quit
+		get_tree().auto_accept_quit = _previous.accept
+		if OS.has_feature("mobile"):
+			DisplayServer.screen_set_orientation(_previous.orientation)
+
+
+func _notification(what: int) -> void:
+	if what in [NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST, NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST]:
+		_send("pause")
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_poll += delta
+	if _poll >= 0.08:
+		_poll = 0.0
+		_poll_state()
+	_publish_layout()
+
+
+func _poll_state() -> void:
+	if _closed or not is_instance_valid(_host):
+		return
+	var raw: Variant = JSON.parse_string(str(_host.call("getTableState")))
+	if raw is Dictionary:
+		apply_state(raw)
+
+
+func _integer(value: Variant, lo: int, hi: int) -> bool:
+	return (value is int or value is float) and is_finite(float(value)) and float(value) == floor(float(value)) and value >= lo and value <= hi
+
+
+func _hex(value: Variant, length: int) -> bool:
+	if not value is String or value.length() != length:
+		return false
+	for character in value:
+		if character not in "0123456789abcdef":
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+func _valid_state(value: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	if value.get("schema") != 1 or value.get("game") != "memory" or value.get("token") != _token or not _hex(_token,32):
+		return false
+	if not _hex(value.get("roundId"),32) or not _hex(value.get("owner"),64):
+		return false
+	for key in ["revision","recordRevision"]:
+		if not _integer(value.get(key),1,999999999):
+			return false
+	for key in ["ack","rejected"]:
+		if not _integer(value.get(key),0,1000000000):
+			return false
+	for key in ["paused","canFlip","exit","reduceMotion","rewarded","complete"]:
+		if not value.get(key) is bool:
+			return false
+	if value.get("difficulty") not in LEVELS or value.get("pack") not in PACKS:
+		return false
+	var count: int = COUNTS[LEVELS.find(value.difficulty)]
+	if value.get("count") != count or not value.get("cards") is Array or value.cards.size() != count:
+		return false
+	for index in range(count):
+		var card: Variant = value.cards[index]
+		if not card is Dictionary or card.get("index") != index or not card.get("faceUp") is bool or not card.get("matched") is bool:
+			return false
+		if card.faceUp:
+			if card.get("motif") not in MOTIFS:
+				return false
+		elif card.get("motif") != null:
+			return false
+		if card.matched and not card.faceUp:
+			return false
+	if value.get("turn") not in ["kind","lumo"] or value.get("phase") not in ["select","resolve","botFirst","botSecond","complete"]:
+		return false
+	for key in ["kindPairs","lumoPairs"]:
+		if not _integer(value.get(key),0,count/2):
+			return false
+	if not _integer(value.get("kindMoves"),0,1000000000) or not _integer(value.get("kindStreak"),0,count/2) or not _integer(value.get("remainingMs"),0,900):
+		return false
+	return value.get("line") is String and value.line.length() <= 400 and _integer(value.get("stars"),0,5)
+
+
+func apply_state(value: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	if not _valid_state(value):
+		return false
+	if not _state.is_empty():
+		if value.owner != _state.owner or int(value.revision) < int(_state.revision):
+			return false
+		if int(value.revision) == int(_state.revision):
+			return value == _state
+		if int(value.ack) < int(_state.ack) or int(value.rejected) < int(_state.rejected):
+			return false
+	var new_round: bool = value.roundId != _round
+	_state = value.duplicate(true)
+	_sequence = maxi(_sequence,maxi(int(value.ack),int(value.rejected)))
+	if _pending <= maxi(int(value.ack),int(value.rejected)):
+		_pending = 0
+	if new_round:
+		_round = value.roundId
+		_page = 0
+		_dismissed_result = ""
+		_clear_cards()
+		for index in range(int(value.count)):
+			_cards.append(_create_card(index))
+		_layout()
+	for index in range(_cards.size()):
+		_sync_card(index, new_round)
+	_invalidate()
+	_update_ui()
+	if value.exit and _pending == 0 and is_instance_valid(_host):
+		_closed = HostBridge.durable_ack(_host.call("returnToApp","games",""))
+	return true

+func _send(action: String, extras: Dictionary = {}) -> bool:
+	if _closed or _pending > 0 or _state.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(_host) or not MobileRuntime.safe_area_is_ready():
+		return false
+	if action == "flip":
+		var index := int(extras.get("index",-1))
+		if not bool(_state.canFlip) or bool(_state.paused) or index < 0 or index >= _cards.size() or _animating() or not _cards[index].button.is_visible_in_tree():
+			return false
+		if _state.cards[index].faceUp or _state.cards[index].matched:
+			return false
+	_sequence += 1
+	var request := {"token":_token,"roundId":_state.roundId,"revision":int(_state.revision),
+		"sequence":_sequence,"action":action}
+	request.merge(extras)
+	if not HostBridge.durable_ack(_host.call("submitTableAction",JSON.stringify(request))):
+		status.text = "Eingabe noch nicht bestätigt. Bitte erneut versuchen."
+		return false
+	_pending = _sequence
+	_invalidate()
+	_update_ui()
+	return true

+func _rounded_mesh(width: float,height: float,depth: float) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var points: Array[Vector2] = []
+	var radius := minf(width,height)*0.12
+	for corner in range(4):
+		var center := Vector2((width*0.5-radius)*(1 if corner in [0,3] else -1),
+			(height*0.5-radius)*(1 if corner in [0,1] else -1))
+		for step in range(9):
+			var angle := float(corner)*PI*0.5 + float(step)*PI/16.0
+			points.append(center+Vector2(cos(angle),sin(angle))*radius)
+	var tool := SurfaceTool.new()
+	tool.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	for i in range(points.size()):
+		var a := points[i]
+		var b := points[(i+1)%points.size()]
+		for side in [1.0,-1.0]:
+			var verts := [Vector3(0,0,depth*side/2),Vector3(a.x,a.y,depth*side/2),Vector3(b.x,b.y,depth*side/2)]
+			if side < 0: verts.reverse()
+			for point in verts:
+				tool.set_normal(Vector3(0,0,side))
+				tool.add_vertex(point)
+		var normal := Vector3((a+b).x,(a+b).y,0).normalized()
+		var side_vertices := [Vector3(a.x,a.y,-depth/2),Vector3(b.x,b.y,-depth/2),
+			Vector3(b.x,b.y,depth/2),Vector3(a.x,a.y,depth/2)]
+		for vertex in [0,1,2,0,2,3]:
+			tool.set_normal(normal)
+			tool.add_vertex(side_vertices[vertex])
+	return tool.commit()

+func _sync_card(index: int, immediate: bool) -> void:
+	var card := _cards[index]
+	var public_card: Dictionary = _state.cards[index]
+	var showing: bool = public_card.faceUp
+	if showing and str(card.motif) != str(public_card.motif):
+		var motif: String = public_card.motif
+		if not _textures.has(motif):
+			_textures[motif] = load("res://assets/games/memory/%s.png" % MOTIFS[motif][1])
+		card.front.material_override.albedo_texture = _textures[motif]
+		card.front.visible = true
+		card.motif = motif
+	card.matched.visible = bool(public_card.matched)
+	card.body.material_override.albedo_color = (Color("f8d76a") if public_card.matched else Color("f2d6a7")).srgb_to_linear()
+	card.button.tooltip_text = "Karte %d · %s" % [index+1, MOTIFS[public_card.motif][0] if showing else "verdeckt"]
+	if immediate or bool(_state.reduceMotion):
+		if is_instance_valid(card.tween): card.tween.kill()
+		card.root.rotation.y = 0.0 if showing else PI
+		card.face = showing
+		if not showing:
+			card.front.hide()
+			card.front.material_override.albedo_texture = null
+			card.motif = ""
+	elif bool(card.face) != showing:
+		if is_instance_valid(card.tween): card.tween.kill()
+		card.face = showing
+		var tween := create_tween()
+		card.tween = tween
+		tween.tween_property(card.root,"rotation:y",0.0 if showing else PI,0.46).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
+		tween.finished.connect(_flip_finished.bind(index,showing,_round))
+	if is_instance_valid(card.tween):
+		if _state.paused: card.tween.pause()
+		else: card.tween.play()

+func _choose_grid(count: int,width: float,height: float) -> Dictionary:
+	var candidates: Array[int] = [count]
+	for limit in [12,8,6,4,2,1]:
+		if limit < count: candidates.append(limit)
+	for page_count in candidates:
+		var best := {}
+		var best_area := 0.0
+		for cols in range(1,mini(page_count,8)+1):
+			var rows := ceili(float(page_count)/cols)
+			var cw := minf((width-8*(cols-1))/cols,(height-8*(rows-1))/rows*CARD_ASPECT)
+			if cw < 50.0: continue
+			if cw*cw > best_area:
+				best = {"page_size":page_count,"cols":cols,"rows":rows,"width":cw,"height":cw/CARD_ASPECT}
+				best_area = cw*cw
+		if not best.is_empty(): return best
+	return {"page_size":1,"cols":1,"rows":1,"width":50.0,"height":50.0/CARD_ASPECT}

+func _layout() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(ui): return
+	_invalidate()
+	_density = MobileRuntime.get_ui_density()
+	get_window().content_scale_size = Vector2i(Vector2(get_window().size)/_density)
+	var logical := Vector2(get_window().content_scale_size)
+	var insets := Rect2()
+	if OS.has_feature("mobile") or MobileRuntime.requires_safe_area_observation():
+		insets = MobileRuntime.get_safe_area_insets()
+	var factor := logical/Vector2(get_window().size)
+	_safe_rect = Rect2(insets.position*factor,logical-(insets.position+insets.size)*factor)
+	safe.position = _safe_rect.position
+	safe.size = _safe_rect.size
+	safe.visible = MobileRuntime.safe_area_is_ready()
+	header.position = Vector2(8,5)
+	header.size = Vector2(safe.size.x-16,64)
+	scores.position = Vector2(8,69)
+	scores.size = Vector2(safe.size.x-16,28)
+	var footer_height := 92.0
+	footer.position = Vector2(8,safe.size.y-footer_height-5)
+	footer.size = Vector2(safe.size.x-16,footer_height)
+	_board_rect = Rect2(safe.position+Vector2(12,104),Vector2(maxf(50,safe.size.x-24),maxf(66,safe.size.y-210)))
+	var fox_room := safe.size.x >= 850.0 and safe.size.y >= 480.0
+	if fox_room: _board_rect.size.x -= 170.0
+	overlay.position = Vector2(8,75)
+	overlay.size = Vector2(safe.size.x-16,maxf(80,safe.size.y-83))
+	camera.size = logical.y/100.0
+	var count: int = int(_state.get("count",8))
+	var grid := _choose_grid(count,_board_rect.size.x,_board_rect.size.y)
+	_page_size = int(grid.page_size)
+	_columns = int(grid.cols)
+	_rows = int(grid.rows)
+	_page = clampi(_page,0,maxi(0,ceili(float(count)/_page_size)-1))
+	var grid_size := Vector2(_columns*grid.width+8*(_columns-1),_rows*grid.height+8*(_rows-1))
+	var start := _board_rect.get_center()-grid_size/2
+	var pixel_factor := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size/logical
+	for index in range(_cards.size()):
+		var card := _cards[index]
+		var offset := index-_page*_page_size
+		var visible: bool = offset >= 0 and offset < _page_size
+		card.root.visible = visible
+		card.button.visible = visible
+		if not visible: continue
+		var pos := start+Vector2(offset%_columns*(grid.width+8),floori(float(offset)/_columns)*(grid.height+8))
+		var target := Rect2(pos,Vector2(grid.width,grid.height))
+		card.target = target
+		card.size = target.size/100.0
+		card.root.position = camera.project_position(target.get_center()*pixel_factor,14.0)
+		card.body.mesh = _rounded_mesh(card.size.x,card.size.y,0.11)
+		card.front.mesh.size = card.size*0.92
+		card.back.mesh.size = card.size*0.92
+		card.mark.pixel_size = minf(card.size.x,card.size.y)/110.0
+		card.matched.position.y = -card.size.y*0.35
+		card.matched.scale = Vector3.ONE*minf(card.size.x/0.95,1.4)
+		# Bounds come from the actual projected face. No fixed device tap point.
+		var quad := _card_quad(card)
+		var rect := Rect2(quad[0],Vector2.ZERO)
+		for point in quad: rect = rect.expand(point)
+		card.button.position = rect.position-safe.position
+		card.button.size = rect.size
+	fox.visible = fox_room
+	if fox_room:
+		fox.position = camera.project_position(Vector2(_safe_rect.end.x-86,_safe_rect.position.y+_safe_rect.size.y*0.72)*pixel_factor,12.8)
+		fox.scale = Vector3.ONE*0.74
+	_update_ui()

+	if not is_instance_valid(status): return
+	var ready := not _state.is_empty()

+	var complete := bool(_state.get("complete",false))
+	var waiting := _pending > 0
+	back_button.disabled = not ready or waiting

+	next_button.disabled = (_page+1)*_page_size >= _cards.size() or waiting or _animating()
+	page_label.text = "%d–%d von %d Karten" % [_page*_page_size+1,mini((_page+1)*_page_size,_cards.size()),_cards.size()]
+	if not ready: return
+	scores.text = "Du %d  ·  Lumo %d  ·  %d %s" % [int(_state.kindPairs),int(_state.lumoPairs),int(_state.kindMoves),"Zug" if int(_state.kindMoves)==1 else "Züge"]
+	status.text = "Wird gespeichert …" if waiting else str(_state.line)
+	if _state.get("error") != null: status.text = str(_state.error)
+	overlay.visible = paused or (complete and _dismissed_result != str(_state.roundId))
+	detail.text = "Memory pausiert. Deine Runde bleibt gespeichert." if paused and not complete else str(_state.line)
+	if complete: detail.text += "\n%d Sterne · Dein Ergebnis bleibt gespeichert." % int(_state.stars)
+	resume_button.text = "Brett ansehen" if complete else "Fortsetzen"
+	resume_button.disabled = waiting
+	restart_button.disabled = waiting or (complete and not bool(_state.rewarded))
+	for i in range(level_buttons.size()):
+		level_buttons[i].disabled = waiting or _state.difficulty == LEVELS[i] or (complete and not bool(_state.rewarded))
+	for i in range(pack_buttons.size()):
+		pack_buttons[i].disabled = waiting or _state.pack == PACKS[i] or (complete and not bool(_state.rewarded))

+func _mesh_rect(mesh: MeshInstance3D, camera: Camera3D) -> Rect2:
+	var box := mesh.get_aabb()

+	for index in range(1, 8):
+		rect = rect.expand(camera.unproject_position(mesh.to_global(box.get_endpoint(index))))

+func _geometry_depth(node: Node3D, camera: Camera3D) -> Vector2:
+	var low := INF
+	var high := -INF
+	var inverse := camera.get_camera_transform().affine_inverse()
+	for item: Node in node.find_children("*", "GeometryInstance3D", true, false):
+		if not item.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		var box := AABB()
+		if item is MeshInstance3D and item.mesh != null:
+			box = item.get_aabb()
+		elif item is MultiMeshInstance3D and item.multimesh != null:
+			box = item.multimesh.get_aabb()
+		else:
+			continue
+		for corner in range(8):
+			var position: Vector3 = inverse * item.to_global(box.get_endpoint(corner))
+			low = minf(low, -position.z)
+			high = maxf(high, -position.z)
+	return Vector2(low, high)
